status: planning-only; no TTS, animation, rendered timing or actual listening reviewed

source.idLinesHashEncoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps([{id,lines}...],ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')); scene order preserved; titles excluded
source.binding: scene id plus one-based line number; scene titles are not inputs

scope.output: current-versus-new script comparison and planning only
scope.preserves: spoken draft, source article order, terminology contract, approved PCM and existing outputs
scope.sceneConvention: Current draft: left-handed +X right/+Y up/+Z forward; positive left-hand rotations; intrinsic body Y-X-Z; row-vector Rz(b)Rx(p)Ry(h). Old-version visuals require a convention audit before reuse.

timingContract.sequence: speech concept → show target/action/result → reading/observation opportunity → short check/connection; repeat only at meaningful concept boundaries
timingContract.afterLine: One-based spoken draft line after which the planned visual demonstration begins. The original lines remain continuous speech; this is an editorial cue, not an instruction to cut or regenerate every line.
timingContract.hold: plannedSeconds is an initial observation/read opportunity after the visual result, not obligatory silent time or a runtime cap. Natural breathing, suitable continuing explanation and synchronized original game audio may continue; silenceRequired is always false.
timingContract.notEverySentence: Do not create a fixed pause after every line. Adjacent lines that teach one concept stay in one natural spoken unit.
timingContract.pending: Retiming requires the actual naturally paced voice, readable numeric/code reveals, rendered motion, and listening/viewing; no speed pass is established by this plan.
timingContract.noForcedShortening: No total runtime ceiling. null motion length means determine sufficient native-speed demonstration/calculation time during production; never speed multiple turns or original gameplay to fit the plan.
timingContract.answerReveal: In v6-41.B02/B03 the numeric answer and its motion remain hidden during the question observation, then appear with the mapped result-check lines.
timingContract.canonicalDisplay: Keep X/Y/Z, h/p/b, R, n, θ, e, ω, wrapPi, std::remainder and fmod as canonical display spelling; TTS pronunciation aliases do not replace UI or caption spellings.

validation.coverageSequence: For each scene, concatenate speech.lineNumbers then resultCheckAndConnection.lineNumbers for each successive beat. This equals 1..scene.lines.length exactly.
validation.complexSceneException: v6-26 has four distinct learning units: 1rad definition, conversion/constants, remainder/boundaries, branch/tests; no fixed three-beat cap imposed.

revalidatedAfterTargetedGlosses.actualTimingStatus: pending; longer plain-language glosses must receive natural speech time, not faster delivery
